tool.name: argNorm
tool.description: Normalize antibiotic resistance gene annotations to the ARO ontology and enhance with drug categorization
tool.help:
# argNorm: Normalize ARG Annotations
argNorm is a tool to normalize antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) annotations to the Antibiotic Resistance Ontology (ARO) and enhance annotations with drug categorization.
## Features - Maps ARG annotations to ARO accessions - Adds drug categorization based on ARO ontology - Accepts outputs from various ARG annotation tools
## Usage Provide an annotation file as input. The tool will output a normalized version with ARO mappings and drug categories.
